Effective Date: September 2, 2026

Crafted & Cherished (“we,” “us,” “our,” or the “Website”) operates craftedandcherished.com. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have. By using this Website, you consent to the practices described in this policy.

If you have questions, you can reach us at contact@craftedandcherished.com (please double-check this is your correct contact email before publishing).

1. Information We Collect

a) Information You Provide Directly

We collect information you voluntarily give us, such as when you:

  • Subscribe to our newsletter (“Join the Crochet Circle”) — we collect your email address
  • Submit a message through our Contact page — we collect your name, email address, and message content
  • Submit a project for the “Community Creations” feature or tag us on social media
  • Leave a comment on a blog post (if comments are enabled) — this may collect your name, email address, and website URL

b) Information Collected Automatically

When you visit the Website, certain information is collected automatically through cookies, log files, and similar tracking technologies, including:

  • IP address
  • Browser type and version
  • Device type and operating system
  • Referring/exit pages and URLs
  • Pages viewed and time spent on those pages
  • Date and time stamps
  • Click, scroll, and mouse-movement behavior (see Microsoft Clarity, below)

2. Cookies

Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help websites function and collect information about how visitors use them. We use cookies for site functionality, analytics, and advertising (see Sections 3–5 below). You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings. Blocking cookies may affect your experience on the Website, though it will not prevent you from seeing ads — you will simply see non-personalized ads instead.

3. Google Analytics

We use Google Analytics (via Site Kit by Google) to understand how visitors use our Website — for example, which pages are viewed, how long visitors stay, and what device or browser they use. Google Analytics uses cookies and similar technologies to collect and analyze this information.

You can learn more about how Google collects and processes data at Google’s Privacy & Terms page, and you can opt out of Google Analytics tracking by installing the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on.

4. Microsoft Clarity

We use Microsoft Clarity to better understand how visitors interact with our Website. Clarity uses cookies and similar technologies to collect behavioral and usage data, including:

  • Mouse movements, clicks, and scrolling (session recordings and heatmaps)
  • Page views and navigation paths
  • Device, browser, and approximate location information

This data is used in aggregate to help us improve site layout, content, and user experience. Microsoft and Clarity Partner Microsoft Advertising may use this data for advertising purposes as described in the Microsoft Privacy Statement and Clarity’s own documentation.

5. Mediavine Programmatic Advertising (Ver 1.1)

The Website works with Mediavine to manage third-party interest-based advertising appearing on the Website. Mediavine serves content and advertisements when you visit the Website, which may use first and third-party cookies. A cookie is a small text file which is sent to your computer or mobile device (referred to in this policy as a “device”) by the web server so that a website can remember some information about your browsing activity on the Website.

First party cookies are created by the website that you are visiting. A third-party cookie is frequently used in behavioral advertising and analytics and is created by a domain other than the website you are visiting. Third-party cookies, tags, pixels, beacons and other similar technologies (collectively, “Tags”) may be placed on the Website to monitor interaction with advertising content and to target and optimize advertising. Each internet browser has functionality so that you can block both first and third-party cookies and clear your browser’s cache. The “help” feature of the menu bar on most browsers will tell you how to stop accepting new cookies, how to receive notification of new cookies, how to disable existing cookies and how to clear your browser’s cache. For more information about cookies and how to disable them, you can consult the information at All About Cookies.

Without cookies you may not be able to take full advantage of the Website content and features. Please note that rejecting cookies does not mean that you will no longer see ads when you visit our Site. In the event you opt-out, you will still see non-personalized advertisements on the Website.

The Website collects the following data using a cookie when serving personalized ads:

  • IP Address
  • Operating System type
  • Operating System version
  • Device Type
  • Language of the website
  • Web browser type
  • Email (in hashed form)

Mediavine Partners (companies listed below with whom Mediavine shares data) may also use this data to link to other end user information the partner has independently collected to deliver targeted advertisements. Mediavine Partners may also separately collect data about end users from other sources, such as advertising IDs or pixels, and link that data to data collected from Mediavine publishers in order to provide interest-based advertising across your online experience, including devices, browsers and apps. This data includes usage data, cookie information, device information, information about interactions between users and advertisements and websites, geolocation data, traffic data, and information about a visitor’s referral source to a particular website. Mediavine Partners may also create unique IDs to create audience segments, which are used to provide targeted advertising.

If you would like more information about this practice and to know your choices to opt-in or opt-out of this data collection, please visit the National Advertising Initiative opt-out page. You may also visit the Digital Advertising Alliance website and Network Advertising Initiative website to learn more information about interest-based advertising. You may download the AppChoices app at Digital Advertising Alliance’s AppChoices app to opt out in connection with mobile apps, or use the platform controls on your mobile device to opt out.

For specific information about Mediavine Partners, the data each collects and their data collection and privacy policies, please visit Mediavine Partners.

Note for publishing: The block above is Mediavine’s official required disclosure text (Ver 1.1, updated 05/09/2022). Mediavine’s automated “Privacy Policy Health Check” scans for this exact language, so avoid editing its wording. When you paste this policy into WordPress, make sure this section keeps its original HTML/heading structure (use the HTML/Custom HTML view rather than the visual editor) so the Health Check can detect it correctly.

6. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to:

  • Operate, maintain, and improve the Website
  • Respond to your comments, questions, and contact requests
  • Send our email newsletter to subscribers who opt in
  • Understand site usage and improve content (via Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity)
  • Serve and personalize advertising through Mediavine and its partners
  • Detect, prevent, and address technical issues or fraudulent activity

We do not sell your personal information for money. As described above, our advertising partners may engage in data sharing that is considered a “sale” or “share” of information under certain state privacy laws (see Section 9).

7. Third-Party Links

The Website may contain links to other websites (e.g., social media, other blogs, or shops). We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those third-party sites. We encourage you to review the privacy policy of any site you visit.

8. Children’s Privacy

The Website is not directed to children under the age of 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can delete it.

9. Your Privacy Rights

California Residents (CCPA/CPRA)

If you are a California resident, you have the right to:

  • Know what personal information we collect, use, and share
  • Request deletion of your personal information
  • Correct inaccurate personal information
  • Opt out of the “sale” or “sharing” of personal information (as described in the Mediavine section above)
  • Not be discriminated against for exercising these rights

To exercise these rights, contact us at contact@craftedandcherished.com, or use any “Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information” link provided on the Website (if applicable through your ad partner’s consent tool).

European Economic Area, UK, and Similar Jurisdictions (GDPR)

If you are located in the EEA, UK, or a jurisdiction with similar data protection laws, you have the right to:

  • Access the personal data we hold about you
  • Request correction or deletion of your data
  • Restrict or object to certain processing
  • Request a copy of your data in a portable format
  • Withdraw consent at any time, where processing is based on consent

To exercise these rights, contact us at contact@craftedandcherished.com. Some third-party advertising partners may require you to manage consent directly via a consent management tool displayed on the Website.

Other US State Laws

Residents of certain other US states with comprehensive privacy laws (e.g., Virginia, Colorado, Connecticut, Utah) may have similar rights to those listed above. Contact us to make a request.

10. Do Not Track

Some browsers offer a “Do Not Track” (DNT) signal. Because there is no consistent industry standard for how to respond to DNT signals, our Website does not currently respond to them.

11. Data Security

We take reasonable steps to protect the information we collect, but no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security of your data.

12. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

13. Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your personal information, contact us at:

Crafted & Cherished Email: contact@craftedandcherished.com

Our story

A Digital Sanctuary for the Creative Soul

Built One Stitch at a Time

Welcome to Crafted & Cherished — a cozy corner of the internet dedicated to crochet, creativity, and slow handmade living. If you’ve ever felt the quiet joy of creating something with your own hands, you’re exactly where you belong

Est. 2023

The Story Behind Crafted & Cherished

Crafted & Cherished didn’t begin with a business plan or a polished vision — it began with yarn, quiet evenings, and the simple comfort of stitching after long days. Crochet became my way to slow down, to reconnect with creativity, and to create something tangible in a fast-moving world.

What started as small personal projects soon turned into a desire to share patterns, techniques, and encouragement with others who were also craving a gentler, more intentional creative life. This space grew organically — stitch by stitch — into a place where creativity feels welcoming, not overwhelming.
Today, Crafted & Cherished is a home for crocheters of all skill levels who want to create with confidence, patience, and heart.

Our Philosophy

“Creativity isn’t a rare talent — it’s a practice. Crochet teaches us to slow down, trust the process, and find beauty in progress rather than perfection. Every stitch is a reminder that small, steady effort creates something meaningful.”

What You’ll Find Here

Free Crochet Patterns

Free crochet patterns with step-by-step instructions for wearables, home decor, and simple handmade projects.

Inspiration

Thoughtful crochet stories, slow-living inspiration, and reflections on creativity, mindfulness, and the joy of handmade living—one stitch at a time.

Crochet Blog & Tips

Helpful crochet tips, techniques, and practical advice for makers of all levels.

Crochet Home Decor

Cozy and handmade crochet home decor ideas.

Meet the Founder

Hi, I’m Stephanie

I’m the maker and designer behind Crafted & Cherished, and the voice behind StephanieStitches. My love for crochet began as a simple curiosity and quickly became a lifelong creative companion — one that taught me patience, focus, and the joy of handmade work.

I design crochet patterns, write beginner-friendly tutorials, and share inspiration rooted in slow living and mindful creativity. My approach is simple: crochet should feel approachable, calming, and rewarding — never intimidating.


When I’m not crocheting, you’ll usually find me experimenting with yarn textures, refining patterns, or enjoying quiet moments that fuel creativity. I created this space to be the resource and encouragement I once searched for — a friendly guide reminding you, “You can do this.”

A Note to the Reader

Whether you’re picking up a crochet hook for the very first time or returning to a craft you’ve loved for years, I’m truly honored you’re here. My hope is that Crafted & Cherished inspires you to slow down, trust your creativity, and find joy in the process — not just the finished piece.
Let’s create something beautiful together, one stitch at a time.

Hello there!

I’m Stephanie

I’m the maker, designer, and creative heart behind Crafted & Cherished. What began as a love for yarn and quiet moments of stitching has grown into a space where I share crochet patterns, tutorials, and handmade inspiration for every season of life.

Whether I’m designing a cozy wearable, experimenting with new stitches, or simplifying a pattern for beginners, my goal is always the same: to help you create something beautiful with confidence and joy.

I believe crochet is more than a craft — it’s a way to slow down, connect, and turn simple materials into something meaningful. Here, you’ll find projects made with care, encouragement for every skill level, and inspiration to stitch at your own pace.
